source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT DISTINCT	 			SRC_SYS = 'FAC', 			MARKET = COALESCE(CS.MARKET, GR.MARKET, 'OTHER / UNKNOWN'), 			SUB_MARKET = COALESCE(CS.REGION, (CASE 												WHEN GR.MARKET != 'TX'	THEN GR.MARKET 												WHEN GR.MARKET = 'TX'	THEN 'TX - OTHER / UNKNOWN' 												ELSE 'OTHER / UNKNOWN' 											  END), 'OTHER / UNKNOWN'), 			PRODUCT_LINE = COALESCE(CS.PRODUCT_LINE, GR.PRODUCT_LINE, 'OTHER / UNKNOWN'), 			PRODUCT = ISNULL(CS.PRODUCT, 'OTHER / UNKNOWN'), 			EFF_DATE = M.MEPE_EFF_DT, 			END_DATE = M.MEPE_TERM_DT, 			MEMBER = 'FAC' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), M.MEME_CK)  		FROM REPORTS.FAC_CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG M (nolock)STAGING.CI_CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG (NOLOCK) M   			LEFT JOIN REPORTS.ERMAP_GRGR_GROUP GR (NOLOCK) ON 				GR.GRGR_CK = M.GRGR_CK  			LEFT JOIN REPORTS.ERMAP_CSCS_CLASS CS (NOLOCK) ON 				CS.GRGR_CK = M.GRGR_CK 				AND CS.CSCS_ID = M.CSCS_ID 				 		WHERE M.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y'
